title: gdmbayes: Bayesian and Frequentist Generalised Dissimilarity Modelling in Python

creators.name: Horsley, Harold
creators.affiliation: Department of Engineering Cybernetics, Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)

description: gdmbayes is a Python package for Generalised Dissimilarity Modelling (GDM). It provides a scikit-learn-compatible frequentist GDM estimator (NNLS on I-spline features, matching the R gdm package) and a full Bayesian estimator (spGDMM) built on PyMC/nutpie with Gaussian-process spatial random effects, flexible variance structures and hierarchical predictor-importance weights. It replicates and extends the spGDMM model of White et al. (2024, Methods in Ecology and Evolution).
